content.simple_explanation: Learn Family and Community by understanding the main idea, evidence/examples and how to apply it.
key_points: 9 CHAPTER Family and Community Love and dharma are the flower and fruit of family life.
The family is the fundamental and most ancient unit of any society.
In Indian society today, there are several types of families — from joint families to nuclear families.

A joint family has several generations living together — grandparents, parents, uncles and aunts, 9 ― Family and Community Examples of joint families 137 chapter9.indd 137 03-02-2025 05:03:58 Examples of nuclear families brothers, sisters and cousins.
A nuclear family, on the other hand, is limited to a couple and their children, and sometimes one parent and children.
